rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Devices Using Nonpublic Competitor Data
rules.quote: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may constitute a separate violation, and tenants may seek damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.
rules.summary: Landlords are prohibited from using algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy, with penalties up to $1,000 per violation.
rules.penalty: up to $1,000 per violation, with each month of use for each affected dwelling unit potentially constituting a separate violation

rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Rent Pricing
rules.quote: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.summary: San Diego prohibits algorithmic rent pricing and authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief, and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.
rules.penalty: up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation

rules.title: Prohibition on Coordinated Pricing Algorithms
rules.quote: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al., (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
rules.summary: Berkeley prohibits the use of coordinated pricing algorithms with recurring unit/month violations and private remedies available.

rules.title: Prohibition on Anticompetitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.quote: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.summary: Santa Ana prohibits anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing with private tenant claims and penalties up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Santa Ana Ordinance No. NS-3090 (effective April 2, 2026)
rules.penalty: up to $1,000 per violation and per month

rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Rent Coordination Services
rules.quote: Prohibits a landlord's use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.summary: Jersey City prohibits landlords from using algorithmic rent coordination services with fines up to $2,000 per day.

rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Rent Coordination
rules.quote: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.summary: Hoboken prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
